sections.title: Range and documentation
sections.text: A rare Erythrina species known from Guatemala around Lake Atitlán. The documented type specimen was collected in flower near San Juan La Laguna at about 1,585 m elevation.

sections.title: Flowers and leaves
sections.text: Available species-specific information is limited: the collections consulted document a flowering specimen in February but provide no reliable dimensions for the tree, leaves or fruit. The plate shows genus-level features; not all details can be confirmed for this species.

sections.title: Edibility
sections.text: No food use or species-specific toxicology was established in the sources consulted.
